name: reporting_cycle_cohort
description: Aggregate progress for an assessment cycle across the caller's org subtree (admins see the whole cycle): the self/manager/aligned funnel, lifecycle status counts, at-risk count, the cycle's opened/closed times and the median days from enrolment to alignment. In full mode, grouped breakdowns and per-participant progress with when each milestone happened (enrolled, self and manager assessment complete, alignment started and completed, with who acted) and every role alignment, including re-opens. Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC and record the LATEST occurrence: a re-open clears aligned_at until the next completion. The self/manager completion stamps update on rating events only, so after a role or framework change they can disagree with self_done / manager_done until the next rating. aligned_from / aligned_to (full mode only, UTC dates, inclusive) narrow the participant list to those with an alignment, against any role, completed in that window. Returns no rating values.

cycle_id.description: An assessment cycle's id, from reporting_cycles_list.

aligned_from.description: UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD. Full mode only.

aligned_to.description: UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Full mode only.
